newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING -- MER Telemanagement Solutions Ltd.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING -- MER Telemanagement Solutions Ltd.

text.p: Company Name Mer Telemanagement Solutions Ltd
Total ordinary shares to be offered 2.0 million

Business: Headquartered in Bnei Brak, Israel, the company designs, develops, markets and supports a comprehensive line of telecommunication management solutions that enable business organizations and other enterprises to more effectively manage their communication resources. Use of Proceeds: For expansion of sales and marketing activities, research and development, repayment of certain short-term debt, general corporate purposes, including working capital and the potential acquisition of complementary businesses, products or technologies.
Financial Data in 000s year ended Dec 31:
Note: Bnei Brak is a suburb of Tel Aviv.
